abs: Returns the absolute value of a number.
acos: Returns the arccosine (inverse cosine) of a number, in radians.
acosh: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number.
add_property: Adds a new property to an object, with an initial value and permission bits.
add_verb: Adds a new verb to an object with given name(s), permissions, and argument spec.
all_members: Returns the indices of all elements in a list equal to a given value.
ancestors: Returns the list of an object's ancestors in the inheritance hierarchy.
argon2: Hashes a password using the Argon2id algorithm with configurable cost parameters.
argon2_verify: Verifies a password against a previously computed Argon2 hash.
asin: Returns the arcsine (inverse sine) of a number, in radians.
asinh: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number.
atan: Returns the arctangent of a number, or of y/x given two arguments, in radians.
atan2: Returns the arctangent of y/x, using both signs to pick the correct quadrant.
atanh: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number.
binary_hash: Computes a cryptographic hash digest of MOO binary-string data.
binary_hmac: Computes an HMAC of MOO binary-string data using a given key.
boot_player: Forcibly disconnects a player's active network connection.
buffered_output_length: Returns the number of bytes currently queued for output to a connection.
call_function: Calls a built-in function by name, passing along the given arguments.
caller_perms: Returns the permissions (owner) of the verb that called the currently running verb.
callers: Returns a list describing the stack of verb calls leading to the current verb.
cbrt: Returns the cube root of a number.
ceil: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.
children: Returns the list of an object's immediate children.
chparent: Changes an object's parent, moving it in the inheritance hierarchy.
chparents: Changes an object's set of multiple parents.
chr: Converts integer character codes into a string composed of those characters.
clear_property: Clears a property's value on an object so it inherits from its parent again.
connected_players: Returns the list of currently connected player objects.
connected_seconds: Returns how many seconds a player has been continuously connected.
connection_info: Returns a map of detailed information about a network connection.
connection_name: Returns a human-readable description of a connection's remote address.
connection_name_lookup: Performs a reverse DNS lookup on a connection's remote address.
connection_options: Returns the value of one, or all, configurable options for a network connection.
cos: Returns the cosine of a number given in radians.
cosh: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a number.
create: Creates a new object with the given parent(s), owner, and optional init arguments.
crypt: Hashes a string (typically a password) with a one-way crypt algorithm and a salt.
ctime: Converts a Unix timestamp into a human-readable local time string.
curl: Fetches the contents of a URL over HTTP, HTTPS, or DICT.
db_disk_size: Returns the total size in bytes of the database's on-disk files.
decode_base64: Decodes a base64-encoded string into a MOO binary string.
decode_binary: Converts a MOO binary string into a list of byte values and/or printable substrings.
delete_property: Removes a property definition from an object.
delete_verb: Removes a verb definition from an object.
descendants: Returns the list of all of an object's descendants in the inheritance hierarchy.
disassemble: Returns the compiled bytecode/opcode listing for a verb.
distance: Calculates the Euclidean distance between two n-dimensional coordinate lists.
dump_database: Requests that the server checkpoint (write out) the database to disk.
encode_base64: Encodes a string or binary data as base64 text.
encode_binary: Converts a mix of integers, strings, and lists into a MOO binary string.
equal: Compares two values for equality, treating strings case-sensitively (unlike ==).
eval: Compiles and immediately executes a string of MOO code, returning its result.
exec: Runs an external program, optionally feeding it input, returning its output and exit code.
exp: Returns e (Euler's number) raised to the power of a number.
explode: Splits a string into a list of substrings using a delimiter character.
file_chmod: Changes the permission mode bits of a file on the server's filesystem.
file_close: Closes a previously opened file handle, releasing its resources.
file_count_lines: Counts the number of lines in an open file.
file_eof: Tests whether an open file's read position is at end-of-file.
file_flush: Flushes buffered writes on an open file out to disk.
file_grep: Searches an open file's lines for a substring, returning matching lines and their numbers.
file_handles: Returns a list of the caller's currently open file handles.
file_last_access: Returns the last-access timestamp of a file.
file_last_change: Returns the last inode-change timestamp of a file.
file_last_modify: Returns the last-modified timestamp of a file.
file_list: Lists the names, optionally with type/mode/size details, of files in a directory.
file_mkdir: Creates a new directory on the server's filesystem.
file_mode: Returns a file's permission mode as a string.
file_name: Returns the filename associated with an open file handle.
file_open: Opens a file for reading or writing, returning a file handle.
file_openmode: Returns the mode string a file handle was opened with.
file_read: Reads a specified number of bytes from an open file.
file_readline: Reads a single line of text from an open file.
file_readlines: Reads a range of lines from an open file into a list of strings.
file_remove: Deletes a file from the server's filesystem.
file_rename: Renames or moves a file on the server's filesystem.
file_rmdir: Removes an empty directory from the server's filesystem.
file_seek: Repositions the read/write pointer of an open file.
file_size: Returns the size in bytes of a file.
file_stat: Returns a list of filesystem metadata (size, type, mode, timestamps) for a file.
file_tell: Returns the current read/write position of an open file.
file_type: Returns the type (regular, directory, etc.) of a file.
file_write: Writes a string of bytes to an open file.
file_writeline: Writes a line of text, followed by a newline, to an open file.
floatstr: Formats a float as a string with a given precision, optionally in scientific notation.
floor: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.
flush_input: Discards a connection's queued, unprocessed input lines.
force_input: Injects a line of text into a connection's input queue, as if typed by the player.
frandom: Returns a random floating-point number within a given range.
ftime: Returns the current time as a high-precision floating-point timestamp.
function_info: Returns metadata (name, arg counts, argument types) about one or all built-in functions.
gc_stats: Returns counts of objects in each garbage-collector color/state category.
generate_json: Converts a MOO value into a JSON-encoded string.
getenv: Returns the value of an environment variable on the server's host process.
idle_seconds: Returns how many seconds a connection has been idle.
index: Returns the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string.
is_clear_property: Tests whether a property's value is clear (inherited rather than overridden).
is_member: Returns the index or key of a value within a list or map, or zero.
is_player: Tests whether an object is flagged as a player.
isa: Tests whether an object descends from (is a kind of) a given parent object.
kill_task: Terminates a queued or suspended task, given its task ID.
length: Returns the number of elements in a list or map, or characters in a string.
listappend: Inserts a value into a list, by default appending it at the end.
listdelete: Removes the element at a given index from a list.
listen: Starts listening for new connections on a given port or connection point.
listeners: Returns information about the server's active listening points.
listinsert: Inserts a value into a list, by default at the beginning.
listset: Replaces the element at a given index within a list.
load_server_options: Reloads cached $server_options settings, such as protect_ flags, from the database.
locate_by_name: Quickly searches all objects for ones whose .name property matches a given string.
locations: Returns the chain of nested locations containing an object, up to a base object.
log: Returns the natural logarithm of a number.
log10: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.
log_cache_stats: Writes internal verb-cache statistics to the server log.
mapdelete: Removes a key, and its associated value, from a map.
maphaskey: Tests whether a map contains a given key.
mapkeys: Returns a list of all keys in a map.
mapvalues: Returns a list of all values in a map.
match: Matches a string against a MOO regular-expression pattern, returning match position details.
max: Returns the largest of the given numeric arguments.
max_object: Returns the highest object number ever allocated in the database.
memory_usage: Returns statistics about the server process's memory usage (total, resident, shared, etc).
min: Returns the smallest of the given numeric arguments.
move: Moves an object into a new location, running its exit and enter functions.
new_waif: Creates a new WAIF instance of the calling verb's defining object class.
next_recycled_object: Returns the next recycled (destroyed) object number available for recreation.
notify: Sends a line of text, or binary data, to a connected player.
object_bytes: Returns the number of bytes of memory an object occupies.
occupants: Filters a list of objects to those matching a parent and/or player-flag condition.
open_network_connection: Opens an outbound network connection to a remote host and port.
output_delimiters: Returns the output prefix and suffix strings configured for a connection.
owned_objects: Returns a list of all valid objects owned by a given object.
parent: Returns the immediate parent of an object in the inheritance hierarchy.
parents: Returns an object's list of parents.
parse_ansi: Converts bracketed color/style tags in a string into ANSI escape codes.
parse_json: Parses a JSON-encoded string into a MOO value.
pass: Calls the next inherited (parent's) definition of the currently running verb.
pcre_cache_stats: Returns statistics about the cache of compiled PCRE regular-expression patterns.
pcre_match: Matches a string against a Perl-compatible regular expression, returning capture groups.
pcre_replace: Replaces matches of a Perl-compatible regular expression within a string.
players: Returns the list of all player objects in the database.
properties: Returns the list of properties defined directly on an object.
property_info: Returns the owner and permission bits of a property.
queue_info: Returns information about a player's task queue, or a list of all queued players.
queued_tasks: Returns a list describing all queued (forked or suspended) tasks owned by the caller.
raise: Raises a MOO exception/error value, to be caught by a surrounding try-except.
random: Returns a random integer, optionally within a given minimum/maximum range.
random_bytes: Returns a string of cryptographically random bytes of a given length.
read: Reads a line of input from a connection, suspending the task until it arrives.
read_http: Parses a pending HTTP request or response from a connection's input.
recreate: Recreates a previously recycled object, reusing its old object number.
recycle: Destroys an object, freeing its object number for later reuse.
recycled_objects: Returns a list of all object numbers that have been recycled.
relative_heading: Computes the compass and elevation bearing between two 3D coordinate sets.
remove_ansi: Strips bracketed color/style tags from a string.
renumber: Renumbers an object to the lowest currently unused object number, fixing up references.
reseed_random: Reseeds the server's pseudo-random number generator.
reset_max_object: Resets the server's record of the highest-numbered object to the last valid one.
respond_to: Tests whether an object has a callable verb matching a given name.
resume: Resumes a suspended task, optionally supplying its return value.
reverse: Reverses the order of elements in a list, or characters in a string.
rindex: Returns the position of the last occurrence of a substring within a string.
rmatch: Matches a string against a MOO regular expression, searching from the end of the string.
round: Rounds a floating-point number to the nearest integer.
run_gc: Triggers a run of the server's cyclic garbage collector.
salt: Generates a formatted salt string suitable for use as the second argument to crypt().
seconds_left: Returns the real-time seconds remaining before the current task is forced to suspend.
server_log: Writes a message to the server's log file.
server_version: Returns the server's version string, or a detailed component thereof.
set_connection_option: Sets a configurable option on a network connection.
set_player_flag: Sets or clears an object's player flag, booting its connection if cleared.
set_property_info: Changes a property's owner and/or permission bits.
set_task_local: Sets the value stored in the current task's task-local storage slot.
set_task_perms: Changes the effective permissions of the currently running task.
set_thread_mode: Enables or disables threading for background-capable built-in functions.
set_verb_args: Changes a verb's direct-object/preposition/indirect-object argument specification.
set_verb_code: Replaces a verb's MOO program with new source code, returning any compile errors.
set_verb_info: Changes a verb's owner, permission bits, and name(s).
setadd: Adds a value to a list if not already present, treating the list as a set.
setremove: Removes a value from a list if present, treating the list as a set.
shutdown: Shuts down the server, optionally with a message and an unclean/panic flag.
simplex_noise: Computes coherent (simplex) noise for one to four floating-point coordinates.
sin: Returns the sine of a number given in radians.
sinh: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a number.
slice: Extracts one or more indexed elements from each list, string, or map in a list.
sort: Sorts a list, optionally by parallel keys, with natural or reverse ordering.
spellcheck: Checks a word's spelling, returning suggested corrections if it is misspelled.
sqlite_close: Closes an open SQLite database connection.
sqlite_execute: Executes a parameterized SQL statement against an open SQLite database.
sqlite_handles: Returns a list of currently open SQLite database handles.
sqlite_info: Returns configuration and status information about an open SQLite handle.
sqlite_interrupt: Interrupts a long-running query on an open SQLite database.
sqlite_last_insert_row_id: Returns the row ID of the most recent insert on a SQLite database.
sqlite_limit: Gets or sets a SQLite run-time resource limit for a database handle.
sqlite_open: Opens (or creates) a SQLite database file, returning a handle.
sqlite_query: Runs a raw SQL query against an open SQLite database, returning matching rows.
sqrt: Returns the square root of a number.
strcmp: Compares two strings lexicographically and case-sensitively.
string_hash: Computes a cryptographic hash digest of a string.
string_hmac: Computes an HMAC of a string using a given key.
strsub: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string with another string.
strtr: Translates characters in a string according to corresponding from/to character sets.
substitute: Expands %-substitution patterns in a template using a prior match's capture groups.
suspend: Suspends the current task, resuming it after an optional delay in seconds.
switch_player: Reassigns a live connection from one player object to another.
tan: Returns the tangent of a number given in radians.
tanh: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a number.
task_id: Returns the ID of the currently running task.
task_local: Returns the value stored in the current task's task-local storage slot.
task_perms: Returns the permissions the current task is running with.
task_stack: Returns the call stack of a suspended task, given its task ID.
thread_pool: Reconfigures the number of threads in an internal background thread pool.
threads: Returns a list of currently running background thread task IDs.
ticks_left: Returns the VM instruction ticks remaining before the task is forced to suspend.
time: Returns the current time as an integer Unix timestamp.
tofloat: Converts a value to a floating-point number.
toint: Converts a value to an integer.
toliteral: Converts a value into a string of MOO literal syntax that can reproduce it.
toobj: Converts a value to an object reference.
tostr: Converts arguments to a string, concatenating them without separators (no list/map contents).
trunc: Truncates a floating-point number toward zero, discarding its fractional part.
typeof: Returns the integer type code of a value.
unlisten: Stops listening for new connections on a given port or connection point.
url_decode: Decodes percent-encoded characters in a URL-encoded string.
url_encode: Percent-encodes special characters in a string for safe use in a URL.
usage: Returns system load averages and process resource-usage statistics for the server.
valid: Tests whether an object number refers to a currently existing object.
value_bytes: Returns the number of bytes of memory a value occupies.
value_hash: Computes a cryptographic hash digest of any MOO value's literal representation.
value_hmac: Computes an HMAC of any MOO value's literal representation using a given key.
verb_args: Returns a verb's direct-object/preposition/indirect-object argument specification.
verb_cache_stats: Returns statistics about the server's internal verb-lookup cache.
verb_code: Returns a verb's MOO source code as a list of lines.
verb_info: Returns a verb's owner, permission bits, and name(s).
verbs: Returns the list of verbs defined directly on an object.
waif_stats: Returns counts of live WAIF instances, by class, and those pending recycling.
yin: Yields (suspends briefly) if the task is low on ticks or time, replicating suspend_if_needed.
